svg.text: step 5 is the only skippable one (setup_controller.py:79)
Not in the live scoring path
One frame through the Linux tier
Every arrow is a real call. The classifier and the autoencoder are sequential, not parallel — and each is held back by its own separate gate.

The classifier has no path into protection.py. It writes one field — registry.last_classification — and nothing reads it back into a trip decision; only the autoencoder's confirmed status can start a countdown.
A node that has never been commissioned still gets classified: step 2 runs before the model_path check at step 3, which is where such a node returns.
